findings.rationale: The jump host’s security group exposes SSH to every IPv4 address, which unnecessarily exposes an administrative shell to the public internet.
The escalation role is broadly assumable and its attached policy enables the privilege-escalation path, creating an overly permissive identity boundary.
The connectivity graph links the internet-facing jump security group to the escalation role through an STS role-assumption path, creating a direct exposure-to-privilege chain.
